title: Maximum Sum Circular Subarray
description: Find the maximum possible sum of a non-empty subarray of a circular array.
pseudocode:
1. maxSoFar = nums[0], curMax = 0, minSoFar = nums[0], curMin = 0, total = 0
2. for x in nums:
3.   curMax = max(x, curMax + x)
4.   maxSoFar = max(maxSoFar, curMax)
5.   curMin = min(x, curMin + x)
6.   minSoFar = min(minSoFar, curMin)
7.   total += x
8. return maxSoFar > 0 ? max(maxSoFar, total - minSoFar) : maxSoFar
